title: Final Expression for p_phi
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the canonical momentum p_phi must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Constant of Motion
description: Essential Criteria: The justification that p_phi is a constant of motion must be clearly stated and supported by reasoning.

title: Change in p_phi
description: Important Criteria: The change in the expression for p_phi when the vector potential is modified must be accurately described.

title: Constant of Motion Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The explanation regarding whether the modified p_phi is a constant of motion must be clearly articulated.

title: Use of Variables
description: Optional Criteria: The correct use of variables such as r, theta, and phi in the derivation should be evident.

title: Mathematical Clarity
description: Optional Criteria: The mathematical steps taken to derive the expressions should be clear and logically structured.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign errors in the expressions for momentum or derivatives must be penalized.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any inconsistencies in units throughout the derivation should be noted and penalized.
